## Vendor release-note signal

Preserved SUNMI official-source research recorded PrinterX `1.0.20` in SUNMI release notes dated 2026-06-24. The one-day difference from Maven publication is retained as separate provenance rather than normalized away.

## Upstream binary evidence

Maven Central version directories expose the AAR and checksum/signature files. For example, historical versions such as 1.0.13 and 1.0.16 expose `.aar`, `.asc`, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 metadata upstream.

## Engineering relevance

PrinterX changes require receipt/slip visual regression, callback/error-state verification and compatibility checks against the printer service actually installed on P3/P3 MIX.

## Binary policy

`BINARY-NOT-MIRRORED`: canonical binaries/checksums remain upstream in Maven Central.
